name: org.openrewrite.ruby.migrate.CharacterLiteralToString
description: In Ruby 1.9 and later, characters are simply strings of length 1. That is, the literal `?A` is the same as the literal `'A'`, and there is really no need for the character literal syntax in new code.

name: org.openrewrite.ruby.migrate.UpgradeToRuby1_9
description: This recipe will apply changes commonly needed when migrating to Ruby 1.9.
